title: Replication data and code for: Multidimensional wildlife use in communities surrounding Taï and Mont Péko National Parks, Côte d'Ivoire
description: Village-level and species-level data and the code reproducing the regressions, robustness checks and Figures 2, 4, 5 and S1 of the associated article. Respondent-level data, village names and coordinates are not included; see README.md.
